note: The fuzzer reads the raw input bytes as a pcap file, which contains a DNS query packet.
The DNS packet from the pcap is passed to NetworkInterface::dissectPacket for processing.
After nDPI dissects the packet and detects it as DNS protocol, processDNSPacket is invoked on the flow.
The DNS query name (e.g. 'www.tcpdump.org') was stored by nDPI into ndpiFlow->host_server_name, a char array inside the ndpi_flow_struct allocation. This pointer is passed to setDNSQuery.

code: protos.dns.last_query = v; /* No need to strdup */
note: setDNSQuery assigns the raw pointer v (which points into ndpiFlow->host_server_name inside the ndpi_flow_struct heap allocation) to protos.dns.last_query without duplicating the string.

When the flow is destroyed via GenericHash::cleanup, the destructor calls free() on protos.dns.last_query, which points into the middle of the ndpi_flow_struct allocation, causing an invalid-free ASAN crash.
